description: Use this when the user asks how liquid a Polymarket market is, how much a trade of a given size would really cost, how far it would move the price, or what the order book looks like. Returns the live book for one outcome: best levels, spread, dollar depth near the mid and which side is heavier. With amount it walks the book level by level for a market order (dollars to spend when buying, shares when selling) and returns shares filled, average and worst price, slippage against the mid, Polymarket's taker fee and the breakeven probability.

amount.description: For buy: dollars to spend. For sell: number of shares to sell. Omit to see the book only.

market.description: A polymarket.com link, or a market or event slug from pm_search.

outcome.description: Which outcome: "Yes"/"No", a team name, or for a multi-outcome event the outcome label ("25 bps decrease"). Default: the first outcome (usually Yes).

name: pm_book
title: Order book and fill cost
